stories.title: En travaux, la Fondation de l’Hermitage rayonne

en.title: Under renovation, the Hermitage Foundation shines
en.summary: The Hermitage Foundation, closed since autumn 2025 for renovations, continues its activities through an outreach program. The work improves the building's energy efficiency, upgrades security systems, and modernizes exhibition equipment.

stories.title: Roger Dubuis: quand les savoir-faire et l’innovation donnent du relief au temps

en.title: Roger Dubuis: when craftsmanship and innovation give depth to time
en.summary: Roger Dubuis unveils the Excalibur Perpetual Calendar Retrograde, turning complex watchmaking into visible design. The perpetual calendar accounts for varying month lengths and leap years without requiring adjustment until 2100.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Trump entlarvt die Show von Big Tech – auch Bern und Berlin sollten sich nicht blenden lassen

en.title: COMMENTARY - Trump exposes Big Tech's show – Bern and Berlin should not be dazzled either
en.summary: A commentary argues that Silicon Valley's apocalyptic scenarios are calculated strategies. Policymakers and businesses should counter Big Tech's messaging with data sovereignty rather than fear.

stories.title: DER ANDERE BLICK MIT DATEN - Der deutsche Exodus in die Schweiz

en.title: A DIFFERENT PERSPECTIVE WITH DATA - The German exodus to Switzerland
en.summary: German emigrants increasingly choose Switzerland as their destination country. The reasons for this migration pattern are clearly identifiable.

stories.title: GASTKOMMENTAR - Europäische Zentralbank: vier Präsidenten, drei Schritte in die falsche Richtung

en.title: GUEST COMMENTARY - European Central Bank: four presidents, three steps in the wrong direction
en.summary: Over two decades, the ECB has expanded its role from market maker to lender of last resort to a catch-all institution, which has been detrimental to the institution.

stories.title: Reicht es Ende Monat nicht mehr für die Miete, bitten immer mehr Menschen online um Geld. Die Plattform Gofundme verdient damit

en.title: When rent money runs out at month's end, more people turn to online crowdfunding. Gofundme profits from this.
en.summary: Rising costs for housing and heating have increased reliance on crowdfunding platforms, which serve as indicators of economic hardship.

stories.title: «Mr. President, Ihre Massnahmen gegen die Migration gehen zu weit»: Die republikanische Abgeordnete Salazar greift Trump frontal an

en.title: "Mr. President, Your Immigration Measures Go Too Far": Republican Representative Salazar Directly Attacks Trump
en.summary: A Republican congresswoman from Miami publicly criticizes the administration's migration policies, concerned about losing Latino voters in midterm elections.

stories.title: Die Wahlen im Nordosten Deutschlands sind auch ein Votum über Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz

en.title: Elections in Northeast Germany Are Also a Vote on Chancellor Friedrich Merz
en.summary: The AfD is expected to significantly increase its vote share in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, while CDU and SPD face substantial political stakes in these regional elections.

stories.title: Les Eglises suisses ont continué de perdre des fidèles en 2025

en.title: Swiss Churches Continued to Lose Members in 2025
en.summary: Switzerland's national churches experienced fewer departures in 2025 than the previous year, yet membership decline persisted in the Catholic and Reformed Evangelical churches. Religious baptisms and marriages also decreased.

stories.title: Actifs de Nestlé saisis «temporairement» en Russie, une première troublante pour la Suisse

en.title: Nestlé assets seized "temporarily" in Russia, a troubling first for Switzerland
en.summary: Russian authorities placed Nestlé's factories under temporary administration of an unknown company following a Kremlin decree. The move marked the first time Switzerland's largest food company faced such seizure since Russia's 2022 Ukraine invasion.

stories.title: En graphiques – Les Eglises suisses continuent de perdre des fidèles

en.title: In charts – Swiss churches continue to lose faithful members
en.summary: Swiss national churches experienced continued membership decline in 2025, though at a slower pace than previously. Religious baptisms and marriages decreased and did not offset departures and deaths.

stories.title: Les actifs de Nestlé en Russie transférés à une société russe, deux sociétés françaises aussi touchées

en.title: Nestlé assets in Russia transferred to Russian company, two French companies also affected
en.summary: Russia transferred Nestlé's assets to a Russian entity under a Kremlin decree, with French retailers Auchan and former Leroy Merlin group facing similar measures. Moscow cited "unfriendly countries" as justification.

stories.title: Die Schweizer Organisation Macroscopic Ventures wurde mit Anthropic reich – ihr Mitgründer sagt: «In einigen Jahren wird KI die physische Welt direkt beeinflussen»

en.title: Swiss organization Macroscopic Ventures became wealthy with Anthropic – its co-founder says: "In a few years, AI will directly influence the physical world"
en.summary: Macroscopic Ventures, a Swiss organization, has invested millions in researching AI risks as industry leaders warn about dangers of the technology. Co-founder Jonas Vollmer discusses concerns about giving AI increasing control.

stories.title: Afrikas reichster Mann reitet auf einer Erfolgswelle. Nun startet er den bisher grössten Börsengang auf dem Kontinent

en.title: Africa's richest man rides a wave of success. Now he launches the continent's largest IPO to date
en.summary: Aliko Dangote transformed Nigeria's economy through a large refinery project and is now taking it public in what he describes as an IPO for ordinary people.

stories.title: Trotz Sanktionen schickt Nordkorea Arbeiter ins Ausland – und verdient so bis zu 800 Millionen Dollar

en.title: North Korea sends workers abroad despite sanctions – and earns up to 800 million dollars this way
en.summary: North Korean workers are increasingly deployed in Russia and other countries, with the majority of their earnings directed to the Kim regime despite international sanctions.

stories.title: Wieso so viele Ostdeutsche die AfD wählen und was das für Europa bedeutet

en.title: Why so many East Germans vote for the AfD and what it means for Europe
en.summary: The right-wing AfD's success in eastern Germany stems from experiences of upheaval and loss, with implications for broader European geopolitics.

stories.title: Israel führt den Krieg der Zukunft

en.title: Israel leads the war of the future
en.summary: The Israeli military employs technologies and strategies that may become widespread in Europe. European armies have lessons to learn from Middle Eastern military developments.
